newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close down amid selling pressure.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed down sharply amid selling pressure by investors wary about the bad shape of the banking sector, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index fell 45 points or 5.42 percent at 959.7 on a turnover of 38.6 million taka. Losers led gainers by 120 to three. "The market sentiment suffered seriously after a recent report that the banking sector is in a very bad shape," said one broker.
Leasing company IDLC lost 194 taka to 1,977, Amam Sea Food Industries shed 223 to 2,648 and Beximco Pharmaceuticals fell 7.97 to 101.79. ((-- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363))
